name: nemotron-3.5-asr-arabic-dialectal
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-07. A full fine-tune (not LoRA) of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (638M NeMo cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT) for multi-dialect Arabic, no vocab swap, `ar` prompt conditioning. Shipped as a single run4-nemotron-asr.nemo archive plus the training and eval scripts, so parameter count and architecture are inherited from the base record rather than re-derived here. Recorded as a contender because the card prints a Base (zero-shot) / This model column pair on one held-out set. Caveats: the fine-tuning corpus is PRIVATE and about 62% of rows carry harakat and 28% non-verbal tags before cleaning, so the dataset cannot be inspected; the card itself labels the model private/internal and says to evaluate before production use; the 932-clip test set is the same private dataset's split, so the number is in-domain. The card's own comparison table also shows this model is beaten on the same set by whisper-large-v3-turbo (0.344) and cohere-transcribe-arabic (0.357), and states the model's edge is low-latency streaming, not peak WER. Licence other (card carries no license_name), repo created 2026-07-08.

benchmarks.name: dialectal-arabic-lahgtna-v2 test WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results (932-clip held-out test set)' table: 'Base (nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, zero-shot) 0.592' vs 'This model (fine-tuned) 0.422'. Card prints fractional WER; converted to percent (0.422 -> 42.2, base 0.592 -> 59.2). Same clean_text scoring (strip tashkil + tags) on the card's own comparison table. Full fine-tune, 6000 steps, LR 1e-4. Training set and 932-clip test set are private and augmented; card labels the model private/internal.
